def export_csv(path):
    items = json.load(open(path))
    out = Path(path).with_suffix(".csv")
    fields = list(dict.fromkeys(k for i in items for k in i))
    with open(out, "w", newline="") as f:
        writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=fields)
        writer.writeheader()
        writer.writerows(items)
    return out

from invoice import export_csv, total


def test_total(tmp_path):
    p = tmp_path / "i.json"
    p.write_text('[{"qty": 2, "price": 3}]')
    assert total(str(p)) == 6


def test_export_csv(tmp_path):
    p = tmp_path / "i.json"
    p.write_text('[{"qty": 2, "price": 3}, {"qty": 1, "price": 5, "desc": "a, b"}]')
    out = export_csv(str(p))
    assert out == tmp_path / "i.csv"
    assert out.read_bytes() == b'qty,price,desc\r\n2,3,\r\n1,5,"a, b"\r\n'
